win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 19. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

specials.name: JUNGLE BUSH
specials.behavior: The Jungle Bush symbol is a revealing symbol that shows one of the other paying symbols when it lands. All Jungle Bush symbols reveal the same symbol.

modes.name: BONUS FEATURE
modes.trigger: Landing 3 BONUS symbols at the same time during the Bonus Feature award 5 additional free spins.
modes.effects:
Landing at least 3 BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game activates the Bonus Feature.

 3 BONUS symbols award 12 free spins.

 4 BONUS symbols award 14 free spins.

 5 BONUS symbols award 16 free spins.

 During the Bonus Feature, Jungle Bush symbols can also reveal Golden Egg symbols. Each Golden Egg symbol will show a multiplier value between x1 - x10, x25, x50, x100 or x200. Golden Egg multipliers are progressively added to the global Win Multiplier and kept through the Bonus Feature.

 The Win Multiplier multiplies the value of all winning lines with the currently shown multiplier!

 Landing 3 BONUS symbols at the same time during the Bonus Feature award 5 additional free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.
